{{Quote|Very recently, our Boss was taken prisoner by one of the bombad evil tribes!|A Gungan villager to Gallo|audio=GN2-TRECG-L26.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
During a [[War of the Gungan tribes|war]] between the tribes of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="GB" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Hoxie]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Otoh Raban]] was '''kidnapped''' by the [[Rogoe's army|forces]] of the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] Boss [[Rogoe/Legends|Rogoe]]. The abduction was carried out as part of Rogoe's plan to keep the Gungan tribes at war with each other, which would allow him to [[Slavery/Legends|enslave]] members of the smaller tribes and profit from the discord. Hoxie was held captive in a [[Rogoe's stronghold|stronghold]] north of his city while the leaderless inhabitants of Otoh Raban continued participating in the war.<ref name="GB" />

Shortly after the kidnapping, Boss [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]], a Gungan who was uniting the tribes against Rogoe, arrived at Otoh Raban seeking an alliance. A [[Unidentified Gungan villager (Otoh Raban)|resident]] of the city informed him of Hoxie's abduction, promising that the Gungans of Otoh Raban would join Gallo's cause upon the rescue of their boss. Gallo then [[Battle of the Forest Cities|attacked]] the stronghold with his [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|army]], freeing Hoxie and gaining the allegiance of him and his tribe.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Boss Hoxie's kidnapping was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]].<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref> It served as part of the background of of a mission in "The Gungan who would be Boss," the second level of the Gungan campaign in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref>
